UnitStatement: HandoffPanel React component renders a local review handoff package from a preview model, knowledge, mechanics result, analysis run, comparison, editor intents, proposal, and selected review target.
Handoff package is exported as a downloadable local JSON file named openpipestress-preview-handoff-<token>.json via a data URI, with no server upload.
buildHandoffPackage assembles a handoff package document of kind openpipestress.technical_preview.handoff_package with export_scope local_browser_download_preview.

Handoff loss report declares delegated, omitted, approximated, and unsupported behavior references; unsupported items include that protected code/rule criteria are not bundled and target-specific commercial-solver field mapping is not generated.
Handoff stable_id_map records id_basis as model entity IDs and computed result IDs, with entity_refs and selected_result_refs as stable cross-reference anchors.
Handoff target_mapping uses profile native_open_json_preview with mapping_status stable_ids_only_not_target_specific and policy loss_report_required_before_target_specific_export.
Handoff package asserts release_or_professional_claim is false and professional_boundary requires human review while making no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
stableEntityRefs returns a sorted list of stable entity IDs spanning project, materials, nodes, pipe_segments, supports, components, load_cases, and combinations.
handoffBoundary returns a local-review-only boundary string when human review is required and no compliance/approval claim, private payload, protected content, or professional claim is present.
safeFileToken sanitizes a value to a filesystem-safe download token, defaulting to 'preview'.
HeadlessRunnerPanel renders a schema-first headless runner envelope from a preview model, mechanics result, analysis run, and solve-job audit state.
Headless runner output is a local schema-first preview envelope only; final CLI syntax, package scripts, process policy, network policy, filesystem mutation policy, CI, and release matrix remain TBD.
buildHeadlessRunnerPacket builds a runner packet (deliverable DEL-10-05, package PKG-10) with runner_status, tbd_decisions, a solve request, and a result handoff.
Headless runner_status interface_kind is schema_first_headless_runner_contract with final_cli_command_syntax, package_scripts, transport protocol, CI provider, and release matrix all TBD.

physicalProjectContainer declares an sqlite_local_project_store profile (decision SCA-003) where canonical truth is canonical_json_jcs_payload, SQL is not a public contract, no direct SQL or hosted DB access, and no network is required.
runnerDiagnostic normalizes a diagnostic into a runner diagnostic with code, class, severity (error mapped to blocking), source, affected_object, message, remediation, and provenance.
runnerDiagnosticClass classifies a diagnostic as RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, UNIT_WARNING, RUNNER_BLOCKING, or ASSUMPTION_WARNING based on its code and severity.
jobState maps a solve-job state to one of QUEUED, RUNNING, CANCELLATION_REQUESTED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, FAILED, or TBD.
privacyContext declares local_only true, telemetry_allowed false, private_payload_redacted true, and classification public_metadata.
professionalBoundary asserts human review is required and the software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
previewProvenance attributes preview data to an invented preview fixture under a project-invented license with review_status accepted and no protected or private payload.
KnowledgePanel renders design-knowledge records combining stored knowledge records with physics records derived from the mechanics result.
physicsRecords derives computed_mechanics_context knowledge records from warning/blocking result diagnostics and from the computed max-displacement and axial-force summaries.
Computed displacement review record summarizes the max_displacement result_ref with its value, unit, and location_ref and is marked status human_review_required.
Axial-force knowledge record is located by result id result:force:pipe-P-120:axial or by kind element_local_axial_force.

Library manager browser-preview tests pin the desktop-only seam (Phase C3 TP-C3-LIBGUI-001): jsdom has no Tauri runtime, so import documents stay in memory and backend actions report an explicit unavailable diagnostic instead of a synthesized fallback.
A blocked library-import validation has outcome QUARANTINE with blocking findings IMPORT_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED, IMPORT_LIBRARY_METADATA_MISSING, and advisory IMPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Backend library actions in browser preview report the diagnostic LIBRARY-IMPORT-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY and never invoke the Tauri backend.
Validation findings are split along the PRD §13.5 blocking-vs-advisory axis: blocking/quarantine findings block acceptance while review_required findings are advisory.
DEC-036 refuse-to-store: a blocked import yields stored=false and is not written to the local store, while the blocked validation still rides through to the §13.5 display.
buildInventedLibraryImportTemplate builds a private-by-default, provenance-complete document per kind with privacy_class private_user_data, empty records, and redistribution_status private_only.

Private Library Manager (PRD §13/§14.6) imports an already-parsed material/section/component library document, validates it through the DEL-03-07 provenance seam, and persists accepted private imports to the local-only store.

The local library store is private-by-default and persists only an accepted PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY import; a suspected-protected (QUARANTINE) or otherwise-blocked (REJECTED) import is refused and never written (DEC-036).

Imported private libraries are never transmitted, committed, or bundled into public artifacts (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD §13.5/§17.3); every status is a software finding only, never a legal, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance determination.
Supported library kinds are material library, section library, and component library.
Intended visibility options are private (local-only) and public (validation preview); visibility shapes the validation preview only while save always persists to the private local store.
An in-request busy guard disables the draft textarea, kind/visibility selectors, and actions while a backend command is awaiting, so an async response cannot clobber a mid-request edit.
The stored-library list is project-scoped and is cleared when the active project changes, while the authored session draft is intentionally preserved until saved.
parseDraft requires the import document to be a JSON object, reporting LIBRARY-IMPORT-DRAFT-JSON-INVALID for invalid JSON or non-object payloads.

handleValidate routes the draft through validateLibraryImport, partitions findings into blocking and advisory, and reports outcome, accepted, and finding counts; browser preview returns the unavailable diagnostic.
handleSave refuses without a loaded project, saves via saveLocalLibrary, and surfaces the DEC-036 refuse-to-store note when validation findings block the library.

Library boundary note states imported private libraries stay in local project storage only, only an accepted private import is stored (DEC-036), and validation reports software findings, never a legal or professional acceptance claim.
Primitive load categories form a closed set: concentrated_force, distributed_force, concentrated_moment, pressure, thermal, and imposed_displacement.
Combination basis options form a closed set mirroring core/loads/load_case_algebra vocabulary: mechanics, result_state_subtraction, and range_envelope.
Combination range-envelope modes are min, max, min_abs, and max_abs.
LoadCaseManagerPanel manages load cases, primitive loads, and combinations, queuing edits as structured EditorOperationIntent objects via onQueueIntent rather than mutating the model directly.

Load edits are queued as structured operations, applied only after user action, and remain local-session changes until saved; the panel does not add rule-code combinations, protected standards content, or professional approval.

loadMetadataOptions collects distinct status/kind values across load cases plus TBD and a field-specific default (preview_only for status, primitive_user_load for kind), sorting the current value first and TBD last.
nextLoadCaseIdentifier allocates the first unused load:L-<index> id starting at index 300.
nextCombinationIdentifier allocates the first unused combination:C-<index> id starting at index 300.
isLoadCaseDraftReady requires non-empty id, label, kind, status, and provenance and a non-duplicate id before a create-load-case intent is allowed.
isPrimitiveLoadDraftReady requires a valid load case, unique id, existing target, valid direction, finite non-zero magnitude, provenance, and a non-TBD unit.

isCombinationDraftReady enforces basis-specific rules: subtraction needs distinct existing minuend/subtrahend; range_envelope needs unique existing operands and a valid mode; mechanics needs an existing load case and finite factor.

buildCreateLoadCaseIntent emits a structured create EditorOperationIntent (operation_kind create, status proposed, author_type user) targeting an empty load-case shell with primitive loads not inferred.

Every load-manager intent carries an audit_boundary with mutation_route structured_operations_only, direct_model_mutation_allowed false, requires_user_acceptance true, and mutates_accepted_model_state false.
Every load-manager intent carries a professional_boundary requiring human review and making no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.

combinationCreatePayload builds a basis-specific combination payload: subtraction with minuend_id/subtrahend_id, range_envelope with operand_ids/mode, or mechanics with a terms array of load_case and factor.
buildCreateCombinationIntent emits a create combination intent whose source_note records the basis and notes no code/rule combination default is inferred.
buildCreatePrimitiveLoadIntent builds a primitive-load payload with category, target (support/element/node), direction, magnitude value+unit, and dimension, defaulting unit to TBD when absent.
buildLoadMetadataIntent emits a modify update_load intent over a load-case status or kind field with the before value and proposed value (TBD when empty).
buildDeleteLoadCaseIntent emits a delete intent over the whole load-case entity, recording the display string as the before value and not_present as the after value.
buildCombinationBasisIntent emits a modify intent over a combination basis label, noting no code/rule combination default is inferred.
buildLoadMagnitudeIntent emits a modify update_load intent over primitive_loads.<i>.magnitude.value with source_note 'unit metadata required' and a JSON after-value of value and unit.
buildDeletePrimitiveLoadIntent emits a delete intent over an existing indexed primitive load only.
combinationDisplay must stay byte-identical to the engine's combination_delete_display so delete-intent before-state checks pass, formatting id, label, basis, and terms.

unitOptions builds selectable units from the Tauri unit catalog filtered by dimension, labeling each DEC-018 canonical or DEC-018 display, falling back to model metadata when the catalog is unavailable.
primitiveLoadDefaultUnit selects the project default unit per category: distributed_force/length, moment, pressure, temperature, rotation or length for imposed_displacement, else force.
primitiveLoadDraftDimension maps a category to a dimension: force_per_length, moment, pressure, temperature_interval, rotation/displacement, or force.
primitiveLoadUsesPipeTarget returns true for distributed_force, pressure, and thermal; primitiveLoadUsesSupportTarget returns true only for imposed_displacement.
primitiveLoadDirectionOptions returns UX/UY/UZ/RX/RY/RZ for imposed_displacement, rotation_x/y/z for concentrated_moment, and global_x/y/z otherwise.
primitiveLoadSourceNote records, per category, an explicit user-entered note asserting that other load categories (moments, pressure, temperature, imposed displacements) are not inferred.
parseFiniteNumber accepts only a strict signed decimal/exponent numeric string and returns a finite number or null.
Imposed-displacement primitive loads target supports with degrees of freedom UX/UY/UZ/RX/RY/RZ, where RX/RY/RZ are treated as rotational.
